1.text: “Wandikire marayika w'Itorero ryo muri Efeso uti“Ufashe inyenyeri ndwi mu kuboko kw'iburyo, akagendera hagati y'ibitereko by'amatabaza birindwi by'izahabu aravuga aya magambo ati

2.text: ‘Nzi imirimo yawe n'umuhati wawe no kwihangana kwawe, kandi nzi yuko utabasha kwihanganira abanyageso mbi, n'uko wagenzuye abiyita intumwa kandi atari zo, ukabona ko ari abanyabinyoma.

3.text: Uzi kwihangana kandi warenganirijwe izina ryanjye ntiwacogora.

4.text: Ariko rero mfite icyo nkugaya, ni uko waretse urukundo rwawe rwa mbere.

5.text: Nuko ibuka aho wavuye ukagwa wihane, ukore imirimo nk'iya mbere kuko nutabikora nzaza aho uri, nkūre igitereko cy'itabaza cyawe ahacyo nutihana.

6.text: Ariko rero ufite icyo ngushimira, ni uko wanga imirimo y'Abanikolayiti, iyo nanjye nanga.’

7.text: “Ufite ugutwi niyumve ibyo Umwuka abwira amatorero.“Unesha nzamuha kurya ku mbuto z'igiti cy'ubugingo kiri muri Paradiso y'Imana.

8.text: “Wandikire marayika w'Itorero ry'i Simuruna uti“Uwa mbere ari na we w'imperuka, uwari warapfuye none akaba ari muzima aravuga aya magambo ati

9.text: ‘Nzi amakuba yawe n'ubukene bwawe, (ariko rero uri umutunzi), n'uko utukwa n'abiyita Abayuda nyamara atari bo, ahubwo ari ab'isinagogi ya Satani.

10.text: Ntutinye ibyo ugiye kuzababazwa. Dore Satani agiye gushyirisha bamwe muri mwe mu nzu y'imbohe kugira ngo mugeragezwe, kandi muzamara iminsi cumi mubabazwa. Ariko ujye ukiranuka uzageze ku gupfa, nanjye nzaguha ikamba ry'ubugingo.’

11.text: “Ufite ugutwi niyumve ibyo Umwuka abwira amatorero.“Unesha nta cyo azatwarwa n'urupfu rwa kabiri.

12.text: “Wandikire marayika w'Itorero ry'i Perugamo uti“Ufite inkota ityaye ifite ubugi impande zombi aravuga aya magambo ati

13.text: ‘Nzi aho uba ko ari ho intebe y'ubwami bwa Satani iri, nyamara ugakomeza izina ryanjye ntiwihakane kunyizera, ndetse no mu minsi ya Antipa umugabo wakiranukiraga kumpamya, wiciwe iwanyu aho Satani aba.

14.text: Ariko rero mfite bike nkugaya, kuko iwanyu ufite abakomeza inyigisho za Balāmu, wigishije Balaki gushyira igisitaza imbere y'Abisirayeli kugira ngo barye intonōrano kandi basambane.

15.text: Nawe ni ko umeze, ufite abakomeza inyigisho z'Abanikolayiti nka bo.

16.text: Nuko wihane kuko nutihana nzaza aho uri vuba, ndwanye abo mbatikure inkota yo mu kanwa kanjye.’

17.text: “Ufite ugutwi niyumve ibyo Umwuka abwira amatorero.“Unesha nzamuha kuri manu yahishwe, muhe n'ibuye ryera ryanditsweho izina rishya ritazwi n'umuntu wese keretse urihabwa.

18.text: “Wandikire marayika w'Itorero ry'i Tuwatira uti“Umwana w'Imana, ufite amaso asa n'ibirimi by'umuriro n'ibirenge bye bigasa n'umuringa w'umuteke aravuga aya magambo ati

19.text: ‘Nzi imirimo yawe n'urukundo rwawe no kwizera kwawe, no kugabura kwawe no kwihangana kwawe, n'uburyo imirimo yawe ya nyuma iruta iya mbere kuba myinshi.

20.text: Nyamara mfite icyo nkugaya, kuko ukundira urya mugore Yezebeli wiyita umuhanuzikazi akigisha imbata zanjye, akaziyobya kugira ngo zisambane kandi zirye intonōrano.

21.text: Icyakora namuhaye uburyo bwo kwihana, ariko ntiyashaka kwihana ubusambanyi bwe.

22.text: Dore nzamugusha ku buriri, mutezane amakuba menshi n'abasambane be nibatihana imirimo yabo mibi.

23.text: Kandi n'abana be nzabicisha urupfu, amatorero yose amenye yuko ari jye urondora ubwenge n'imitima, kandi ko nzītura umuntu wese wo muri mwe ibikwiriye ibyo yakoze.

24.text: “ ‘Ariko mwebwe mwese abasigaye b'i Tuwatira, badakurikiza izo nyigisho kandi batazi ibyo ba bandi bīta ubwiru (ari bwo bwiru bwa Satani!) Ndababwira nti: Nta wundi mutwaro mbīkoreza keretse uyu,

25.text: ko mukomeza ibyo mufite mukageza aho nzazira.’

26.text: “Unesha akitondera imirimo yanjye akageza ku mperuka, nzamuha ubutware bwo gutwara amahanga yose,

27.text: azayaragiza inkoni y'icyuma nk'aho ari inzabya z'ibumba, ayiyamenagurize rimwe nk'uko nanjye nabihawe na Data.

28.text: Kandi nzamuha Inyenyeri yo mu ruturuturu.

29.text: “Ufite ugutwi niyumve icyo Umwuka abwira amatorero.
